findings.claim: --dry-run still deletes: the rm runs after the dry-run branch, not instead of it
findings.suggestion: Move the rm into an else branch of the dry-run test, so a dry run only prints.

findings.claim: --pattern given last with no value stops on an unset $2 under set -u, with no usage text
findings.suggestion: Check that a value follows --pattern before reading $2, and print the usage with exit 2 when it doesn't.

findings.claim: die exits 1, so the new option's errors exit 1, though a usage error must exit 2
findings.suggestion: Give lib/common.sh a usage-error helper that exits 2, and use it for the argument errors.
